workflowItem.title: Special Events Audit
workflowItem.description: Manual review of asset deletes, major movement, outside-event observations, and processing errors for Special Event Operations - Pedder.

reviewers.title: Special Events — Audit Reviewers
reviewers.description: Operations staff who investigate movement-audit exceptions.

supervisors.title: Special Events — Audit Supervisors
supervisors.description: Supervisors who approve escalation and closure.

diagram.name: Special Events Audit Review
diagram.description: Review an automated audit exception, select the required source-data action, wait for and verify the correction or deletion, document resolution, and close.

steps.name: Exception Created
steps.prompt: An audit exception was created by scheduled change tracking.

steps.name: Review Audit Evidence
steps.prompt: Review the source asset, snapshots, movement trail, timestamps, event assignment, and processing details.

steps.name: Valid Exception?
steps.question: Does this exception require corrective action?

steps.name: Supervisor Decision
steps.prompt: Review the exception and determine whether the source record must be corrected, removed, or resolved without a source-data change.

steps.name: Required Source Action
steps.question: What action is required to resolve this exception?

steps.name: Waiting for Source Correction
steps.prompt: Keep the job at this step until the EventStaffing source record is updated. The EventStaffing Updates webhook connection will release the dependency when configured.

steps.name: Verify Source Correction
steps.prompt: Confirm the source record contains the requested correction and that the resulting audit event is complete.

steps.name: Waiting for Asset Deletion
steps.prompt: Keep the job at this step until the EventStaffing source record is deleted. The EventStaffing Deletes webhook connection will release the dependency when configured.

steps.name: Verify Asset Deletion
steps.prompt: Confirm the source record is absent and that its last-known geometry and delete audit event were retained.

steps.name: Document Resolution
steps.prompt: Record the verified resolution, source-data action, dispatch or recovery action, and any follow-up required.

steps.name: Document False Positive
steps.prompt: Explain why the exception is expected or a false positive.

steps.name: Audit Closed
steps.prompt: Confirm the audit exception is resolved and close the job.

jobTemplates.name: Special Events Audit Exception
jobTemplates.description: Manual review for delete, major move, outside-event, or processing-error exceptions generated by scheduled processing.
